{{Quote|There's a colony on Thuna III, in a small system near the Unknown Regions, that's been devastated by a groundquake.|Mavven|<ref name="Scavenger's Guide">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Thuna III''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Scavenger's Guide" /> located within [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]] [[Thuna system/Legends|Thuna system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]'' establishes that the production of [[MEV-series medical evacuation droid]]s began ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which corresponds to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. According to ''Scavenger's Guide to Droids'', a MEV-series [[Medical droid/Legends|droid]] was involved in the consequences of the [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] on Thuna III, therefore the disaster must have occurred at some point by that date.</ref> a [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] on Thuna III was devastated by a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]]. In the wake of the disaster, a band of raiders intended to pillage the settlement.<ref name="Scavenger's Guide" />

{{RPGseed}}
The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Mavven]], who had learned of the colony's plight and the threat of the raiders, recruited a group of individuals that had a [[MEV-series medical evacuation droid]] to travel to Thuna III and assist the colonists with evacuation. When the group arrived at the colony, it provided the locals with [[Medic/Legends|medical]] assistance and stopped the raiders from enacting their plans.<ref name="Scavenger's Guide" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Thuna III was first mentioned in ''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]'', a [[2009]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. ''Scavenger's Guide to Droids'' described the astronomical object in a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure seed, which this article assumes plays out as described.<ref name="Scavenger's Guide" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the 2009 reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Thuna [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Thuna III, in grid square I-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
